paragraphs.text: Hurska Sweet-Tooth is legendary bear from an unknown plane, potentially from Eldraine .

Hurska Sweet-Tooth is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Green Dinner deck . They are a large bear with purple and pink fur. They are called Sweet-Tooth as they are seen to love honey. As they are seen with bumblesheep, they may be from Eldraine, as that is the only known plane containing the insects.
